summary: SOPHiA GENETICS SA filed a Form 6-K announcing a non-binding Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center to explore forming a joint venture for a precision oncology hub. No definitive terms, price, or timeline were disclosed; the MOU outlines a strategic collaboration to combine MSK's clinical data with SOPHiA's AI platform. The filing is a preliminary announcement with no binding deal, so it falls outside standard special-situation categories. Watch for subsequent definitive agreements or material developments.
